description: Estimate the USD cost of running a GPU model for a number of hours on CoreHu, from the cheapest free machine right now. Estimate only; nothing is reserved. available=false means no matching machine is free.

gpuCount.description: Number of GPUs in one machine (1–16, default 1)

gpuModel.description: Exact GPU model name as shown by get_gpu_prices, e.g. "RTX 4090"

hours.description: How many hours the job runs

name: estimate_cost

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, null if unknown

diskGb.description: Disk space in GB this machine offers; a template needs its diskGb (list_templates) to fit. Null if unknown

offerId.description: Offer id; pass it to prepare_rental to rent this machine

rentUrl.description: Page where the user can rent this offer in the browser

usdPerHour.description: Hourly USD price for the whole machine, default disk included

title: Estimate job cost
